b.text: William Dwight Whitney was born in Northampton, Massachusetts.
Whitney died at his home on Whitney Avenue.

a.text: Whitney became a founder and first president of the American Philological Association.

b.text: Whitney became Yales professor of comparative philology.

a.text: Whitney was editor-in-chief of the first edition of the Century Dictionary, which appeared from 1889 to 1891.

b.text: The Century Dictionary was edited, starting in 1889.

a.text: The Century Dictionary's appearance ended in 1891.

b.text: The editing of The Century Dictionary ended in 1891.

a.text: On Material and Form in Language was published in 1872.

b.text: Oriental and Linguistic Studies — First Series was published in 1872.

a.text: Oriental and Linguistic Studies — Second Series was published in 1874.

b.text: Darwinism and Language was published in 1874.

a.text: Language and its Study: with Special Reference to the Indo-European (lectures) was published in 1880.

b.text: Logical Consistency in Views of Language was published in 1880.

a.text: Practical French Grammar was published in 1887.

b.text: A Compendious German and English Dictionary was published in 1887.
